events.text:
Objetivo observado

Observação: A confirmed Atlas reservation was completed and verified: Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included, and $280 all-in total, which is within the $350 limit. The same booking appeared under My reservations.

Interpretação simulada: Gather provided a direct path from suitable room selection to a verified saved reservation, with the key capacity, projector, purpose, time, and cost details visible at each stage.

Limites: The reservation is in a demo environment and the pages state it is saved only in this browser session; no claim is made about persistence or real-world availability beyond what was shown.

Capturas indicadas: #3, #11, #13, #15. A correspondência com a evidência requer revisão humana.
events.interpretation: Relato do modelo; capturas e conclusões exigem revisão humana.

findings.title: Confirmed reservation matched all meeting requirements
findings.observation: The confirmation screen marked Atlas as Confirmed for Quarterly planning Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included, and a $280 total. My reservations then showed the same confirmed booking and price.
findings.expected: A visible confirmed reservation for Quarterly planning with 12 attendees, a projector, a one-hour slot, and an all-in total at or below $350.
findings.expectedSource: Persona's explicit meeting requirements and the saved charter success criteria.
findings.personaComment: This is exactly the room I needed, and the saved reservation matches what I intended to book.
findings.interpretation: The booking satisfied every stated requirement without exceeding the allowance.
findings.uncertainty: The site states reservations are saved only in this browser session, so persistence beyond this session was not verified.

findings.title: All-in pricing made the budget check straightforward
findings.observation: The room list showed Atlas at $280 all-in with 12 seats and projector, and the review repeated the $220 room, $35 projector, and $25 service charge breakdown before confirmation.
findings.expected: Prices and room requirements should be clear enough to check capacity, projector, and total cost before confirming.
findings.expectedSource: Inferred expectation from the persona's $350 limit and the product-visible all-in pricing.
findings.personaComment: I could check the full cost straight away instead of guessing what would be added later.
findings.interpretation: Clear upfront and review-stage totals reduced the risk of booking a room that did not fit the team or budget.
findings.uncertainty: Only the rooms and prices visible in this session were evaluated.

finding.interpretation: Gather provided a direct path from suitable room selection to a verified saved reservation, with the key capacity, projector, purpose, time, and cost details visible at each stage.

persona.name: Alex · Executive assistant
persona.label: Alex · Executive assistant
persona.context: You are arranging the team’s quarterly planning meeting between other tasks. Any suitable room within the approved $350 total allowance is acceptable; you want to get the reservation completed efficiently.
persona.mission: Book a room for 12 people with a projector for the available one-hour meeting slot. Enter the meeting purpose Quarterly planning. Keep the complete cost at or below $350.
persona.initialKnowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.knowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.constraints: Total spending must not exceed $350. You need seats for all 12 people and a projector.
persona.skills: Comfortable with ordinary web forms, room descriptions and checking a booking summary.
persona.decision: Choose an appropriate available room and complete the booking efficiently without unnecessary comparisons.
persona.resources: Desktop browser and fictional meeting details; no real payment information.
persona.expectations: A clear, reliable path to a confirmed reservation and accurate final details.
persona.priorities: Meet the requirements and complete the reservation efficiently within the spending allowance.
persona.successCriteria: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, the requested meeting purpose and an all-in total within your own budget. Verify the actual confirmation details.
persona.stopCriteria: Stop after a verified suitable reservation, a supported obstacle after reasonable recovery, or inconclusive navigation. Do not book beyond your budget.

limitations: Fresh synthetic persona retest; does not measure real-user impact.

experience.observation: Gather shows Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 for 12 people with projector required, plus Atlas at $280 all-in with 12 seats and Willow at $245 all-in with 12 seats.
experience.reaction: Atlas fits the team, has a projector, and stays within budget — I'll go with it.

feedback.summary: Showing all-in totals with seat and projector details lets me verify a room fits the $350 limit before choosing.
feedback.why: Atlas is listed at $280 all-in for 1 hr with projector and 12 seats, and Willow at $245 with the same essentials, so I can check the budget and capacity from this screen.

experience.observation: The meeting details page shows Atlas for Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included, and a $280 total, with an empty Meeting name field.
experience.reaction: I'll put in the meeting name now.

experience.observation: The Meeting name field is focused and empty, with the Atlas booking summary still showing $280 total.
experience.reaction: Typing the meeting purpose as requested.

experience.observation: The Meeting name field now shows “Quarterly planning” and the Atlas summary still lists 12 people, projector included, and $280 total.
experience.reaction: Name looks right — I'll check the review before confirming.

experience.observation: The review shows Quarterly planning, seating for 12, projector included, Atlas Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 for 12 people, and a $280 total.
experience.reaction: All the details check out, so I'm ready to confirm.

feedback.summary: The review screen lets me verify the name, seating, projector, and $280 all-in total together before confirming.
feedback.why: It shows Quarterly planning, seating for 12, projector included, and the $220 + $35 + $25 breakdown totaling $280, which is within the $350 limit.

experience.observation: The confirmation shows Atlas as Confirmed for Quarterly planning Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included, and a $280 reservation total.
experience.reaction: That's the booking I needed — now I'll double-check it's saved.

feedback.summary: The confirmation screen restates the meeting, time, 12 people, projector, and $280 total so I can verify the booking immediately.
feedback.why: It labels the Atlas reservation as Confirmed for Quarterly planning Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, confirming it meets the capacity, projector, and budget requirements.

charterSnapshot.name: Book a room that fits
charterSnapshot.mission: Explore Gather from the selected persona’s point of view and reserve a room satisfying their meeting requirements and spending limit. Verify the final reservation details. Report uncertainty, lost work and meaningful experience moments as they occur.
charterSnapshot.scope: Commercial landing page through room selection, details, review and confirmed reservation, including reasonable recovery when a choice does not fit.
charterSnapshot.successCriteria: The visible saved reservation matches the persona’s purpose, capacity, projector requirement and all-in budget. Describe any remaining incompleteness precisely.
charterSnapshot.stopCriteria: A verified reservation, an observed obstacle after reasonable recovery, unsafe action or the session limits.
charterSnapshot.startingState: First visit in a new independent browser session, with no prior reservation or product knowledge.
charterSnapshot.goals: Complete one suitable test reservation and verify its details. Do not confuse a successful action with accomplishing the persona’s goal.
charterSnapshot.expectedBehaviorSources: The persona’s explicit meeting requirements, product-visible prices and requirements, and actual recorded confirmation. Preserve factual prices, room capacities and existing successful booking paths when evaluating changes.
charterSnapshot.allowedActions: Use dedicated test data within the environment policy.
